title: Measure the depth mix a writer produces
statement: Measure the depth mix of generated questions, such as the share needing reasoning rather than recall, as its own figure against a target, since generators skew and accuracy hides it.
example: A proven generator produced depth-of-knowledge level 2 on 78 of 80 kept items.
detail: Counted from its two kept forms, the reading project's proven generator emitted depth-of-knowledge level 2 on 78 of 80 kept items and did not reliably produce level 1 or 3 even where the standard supported them (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/pr-proposals/ti-courseplans-standards/staged/courses/g5-reading/assessments/G5_PARAMETERS.md`). The next grade's parameters therefore ask for depth to be an explicit generation setting with the kept-item histogram verified (the same file). The output spec for every grade's generator records the same flag: prompted generators tend to over-emit level 2, and level-3 yield must be measured, not assumed (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/pr-proposals/ti-courseplans-standards/staged/docs/standards/generator-output-spec.md`).
against: The counts rest on labels that can be wrong: "p14 `check` is tagged inference, but it is recall (*"clear off"* is quoted). That lowers the real inference share below 36%." (`shadow/content-eval/reports/G3-U1-L13-review.md`, line 155).

evidence.quote: **Honest reality flag (load-bearing):** the **proven G3 generator emitted DOK 2 on 78/80 kept items** (measured from form_a.jsonl + form_b.jsonl) — it does **not** reliably produce DOK 1 or DOK 3 even when the standard supports them.
(honest flag: prompted generators tend to over-emit DOK-2; DOK-3 yield must be measured, not assumed).

Near-perfect curriculum alignment (10.0) and factual accuracy (9.96), but **Inference & Pedagogy is the weak link** at 6.76/10.0, especially for Grade 12 (4.97). Questions tend toward rote recall rather than higher-order thinking.
